title: Europrim
description: euro-prim.com zoominfo.com/c/europrim/1128488637 EURO-PRIM (founded 1998, Grenoble, France) is a local digital printing and reprographics company working together with its sister firm CINRA (est. 2003) as "Europrim & CINRA" — two production sites, ~25 staff, serving students, SMEs, large regional companies and property-management firms. Services cover digital color/B&W printing up to A3+, large-format scanning up to A0, graphic design, finishing, personalized mass mailings (including for homeowners' association meetings) and prefecture-approved numbered event tickets. The business was taken over in 2016 by Fleur Henno and Philippe Baffert-Rey, who modernized the equipment and pushed an online store with 200+ products; it holds a solid 4.2/5 rating on 222 Google reviews. However, on 2 July 2025 the Grenoble commercial court opened redressement judiciaire (receivership)
